mapper.select: SELECT u.id FROM s_user_account u JOIN s_venue_customer c ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.id = #{customerId} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: vc.id AS customerId, vc.venue_id AS venueId, v.name AS venueName, u.contact_name AS contactName, u.phone, vc.status, vc.member_code AS memberCode, vc.activated_at AS activatedAt, vc.created_at AS createdAt, COALESCE(bs.paid_balance_fen, 0) AS paidBalanceFen, COALESCE(bs.gift_balance_fen, 0) AS giftBalanceFen, COALESCE(bs.expiring_gift_balance_fen, 0) AS expiringGiftBalanceFen, bs.next_gift_expires_at AS nextGiftExpiresAt

LEFT JOIN ( SELECT lot.venue_customer_id, SUM(CASE WHEN lot.type = 'PAID' AND lot.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN lot.available_amount_fen ELSE 0 END) AS paid_balance_fen, SUM(CASE WHEN lot.type = 'GIFT' AND lot.status = 'ACTIVE' AND lot.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) THEN lot.available_amount_fen ELSE 0 END) AS gift_balance_fen, SUM(CASE WHEN lot.type = 'GIFT' AND lot.status = 'ACTIVE' AND lot.expires_at = nearest.expires_at THEN lot.available_amount_fen ELSE 0 END) AS expiring_gift_balance_fen, nearest.expires_at AS next_gift_expires_at FROM s_member_balance_lot lot LEFT JOIN ( SELECT venue_customer_id, MIN(expires_at) AS expires_at FROM s_member_balance_lot WHERE type = 'GIFT' AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND available_amount_fen > 0 AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) GROUP BY venue_customer_id ) nearest ON nearest.venue_customer_id = lot.venue_customer_id GROUP BY lot.venue_customer_id, nearest.expires_at ) bs ON bs.venue_customer_id = vc.id

SELECT FROM s_venue_customer vc JOIN s_user_account u ON u.id = vc.user_id JOIN s_venue v ON v.id = vc.venue_id
WHERE vc.user_id = #{userId} AND vc.venue_id = #{venueId} LIMIT 1

SELECT v.id AS venueId, v.name AS venueName, COUNT(vc.id) AS customerCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN vc.status = 'MEMBER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS memberCount FROM s_venue v LEFT JOIN s_venue_customer vc ON vc.venue_id = v.id GROUP BY v.id, v.name ORDER BY v.id
